messages:
oliver: FYI release promo for v2.14.0 failing on the manylinux wheel build step — blocking promote :grimacing:
ci-bot: [buildkite/#4921] wheel-manylinux-x86_64: failed (exit code 1)
ci-bot: logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4921
maria: looking now, could be the manylinux image bump from last week
sasha: saw this locally too — pip wheel step errors with OpenSSL symbols
taylor: paste the failing tail? can we hotfix by pinning openssl-dev in the build image?
oliver: error snippet:
```
ERROR: Failed building wheel for cryptography
error: command '/usr/bin/x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc' failed with exit status 1
ld: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libssl.so.3: undefined reference to `EVP_KDF_derive'
```

maria: yep that's the new libssl API. our manylinux base got upgraded in the docker cache unexpectedly
maria: CI cache likely pulled a newer base image tag during the ephemeral builder spin-up
sasha: we can either pin the manylinux base to the previous digest or force rebuild with a patched builder image
taylor: pinned digest sounds fastest. will that unblock promotion immediately?
oliver: deploy-bot: promote for release v2.14.0 is on hold due to build failure
deploy-bot: promotion blocked — see: https://deploy.redwood.example/releases/v2.14.0
maria: I'm going to push a temp CI config to pin `manylinux2014:2026-02-10@sha256:...` and rerun the job
sasha: if CI passes, we can unhold promote and proceed with canary
maria: pushed patch and retriggered the pipeline — buildkite run 4923
ci-bot: [buildkite/#4923] wheel-manylinux-x86_64: running
ci-bot: [buildkite/#4923] wheel-manylinux-x86_64: succeeded ✅
oliver: thanks — can we promote now? Any rollback considerations if canary shows issues?
release-bot: canary window configured for 30m, automatic rollback on error rate > 3% in traces
taylor: let's promote to canary, monitor metrics + error alerts. if anything spikes we rollback to v2.13.9
sasha: note: follow-up to replace temp pin with a deterministic builder image and add explicit digest to CI cache key
maria: will open a follow-up PR after this release. also adding a note to release notes: "temporary manylinux pin to address wheel build regression"
oliver: OK promoting to canary now :rocket:
deploy-bot: promotion started: v2.14.0 -> canary (10% traffic)
ci-bot: reminder: reindex artifact cache TTL may need manual invalidation if we change base image digests
taylor: good call — I'll watch artifact-store metrics and trigger invalidation if we see cache misses
maria: thx all — postmortem and changelog entry incoming, but we've unblocked the release
